query: Under what circumstances might vendors on the street face legal penalties?
reference_answer:
Harassment of Street Vendors:
Punishment can include imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine up to ₹5,000 under the Tamil Nadu Street Vendors (Protection of Livelihood and Regulation of Street Vending) Rules.
answer: Vendors on the street may face legal penalties if they operate without a permit, sell illegal items, or violate local zoning laws. [System]
